expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Removes Count UTF-16 code units beginning at Index. Removes space characters in place. Removes Prefix when it matches the start under SearchCase and reports success. Removes Suffix when it matches the end under SearchCase and reports success. Appends any FToStringHelper-contributed value to a temporary or existing string. Converts a type-erased Value through the generic formatter and appends it.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Observe receiver, object, collection, callback, diagnostic, or lifecycle state after each void call. Use the returned reference in a follow-up mutation or identity check to prove aliasing. Exercise both true and false outcomes unless the API contract documents a single reachable result.
inputs: Seeded receiver state, the exact mutation arguments, repeated-call behavior, and cleanup or restoration inputs where the operation owns resources.
testScope: void FString.RemoveAt(int Index, int Count); | void FString.RemoveSpacesInline(); | bool FString.RemoveFromStart(const FString& Prefix, ESearchCase SearchCase = ESearchCase::IgnoreCase); | bool FString.RemoveFromEnd(const FString& Suffix, ESearchCase SearchCase = ESearchCase::IgnoreCase); | Text.Append(ContributedValue); | FString& FString.Append(const ?& Value);
